subject: Junior Steel Detailer application, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hi Homes and Granny Flats team,

I'm applying for the Junior Steel Detailer role advertised on SEEK.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I am Melton based, hold a White Card, a driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work.

Your advert says attitude and willingness to learn matter more than past detailing work. On site I reviewed structural and architectural drawings against the work, and my course drawings were done in AutoCAD. I have not detailed steel or used steel detailing software yet, and I am open to discussing relocation to Western Sydney.

Would you be open to a short call about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com

letter.subject: Application for Junior Steel Detailer
paragraphs: I am applying for the Junior Steel Detailer role at Homes and Granny Flats advertised on SEEK. Learning how steel designs become real homes, granny flats and modular buildings, alongside an experienced team, is the kind of start I am looking for.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines, and in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia. I prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, applying Australian Standards and construction requirements, and learned how works move from concept to documentation.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines, first as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and then as a field engineer. I reviewed structural and architectural drawings and checked the work against them to cut down on errors and rework, and I kept site reports, material records and progress reports in order.

I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I live in Melton and am open to discussing relocation to Western Sydney. I have not detailed steel or used steel detailing software yet, and my drafting is from study rather than a paid role, so I would value the training your advert describes.
Thank you for considering my application. Some of my course drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.
